dslRule:
<!id: use.imagedescriptor.registry>
<!description: Use ImageDescriptorRegistry to obtain images from JavaPluginImages descriptors.>
<!severity: WARNING>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.JavaPluginImages.$descriptor.createImage()
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.JavaPlugin.getImageDescriptorRegistry().get(org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.JavaPluginImages.$descriptor)
;;
summary: Replaces direct calls to `createImage()` on `JavaPluginImages` descriptors with a call to the `JavaPlugin`'s `ImageDescriptorRegistry`.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
